en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Ismail Bin Mihran, from Ibrahim Bin Abu Raja’a, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
en.sarwar: 3. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from Isma’il ibn Mehran from Ibrahim ibn abu Raja’ from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Maintaining good neighborly relations increases one’s sustenance.”
